thread:
Maya Chen: Quick proposal  two-week "catalog hygiene" spike. Main output: a compact JSON artifact + small benchmark set for each onboarded model. Keep it ops- and CS-friendly. Thoughts?
Lucas Park: +1. Ops needs tested_gpu, peak_memory_bytes, and canary guidance (pct + regions).
Priya Nair: Add migration_risk (0-5) and a short rationale string so CS can triage outreach and credits.
Ethan Rivera: Pinning semantics: allow_customer_pin: boolean and pin_ttl_days. Default true + 90d. Exceptions via enterprise contract flags.
Maya Chen: For deprecation windows I propose parametric flow: default 120d (60/45/15) but if migration_risk <=1 then 90d (45/30/15). We'll encode rules in the runbook.
DevopsBot: Note: canary pipeline has 16 queued jobs; staggered regional canaries recommended.
Lucas Park: Agreed. Default_canary_pct=25, canary_regions list. Also include compat_shim_required boolean and shim_version if needed.
Priya Nair: Action items: Maya draft schema + PR; Lucas add ops fields and queue constraints; Ethan define pin TTLs and exception process; CS to draft comm templates by migration_risk band. Target PR by Thursday EOD.
Maya Chen: I'll post RFC link when ready and schedule a 30m sync Friday to finalize metrics. Thanks!
